considerations: Check for an authorized support ticket and verify who initiated the session.
Review nearby process and network events for activity after the support session.
A process match cannot establish that a session connected.
description: Find Quick Assist executions for triage alongside help desk records.

evidence.claim: Microsoft observed fraudulent Quick Assist support sessions followed by scripting and certificate-services abuse during the investigated intrusions.
evidence.location: Intrusion case studies and initial access sections

expected_output: One row per matching event in tabular mode. A match supports triage.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.
Revalidated after changes to profiles, source_published, tags, evidence, variants, primary_table.

hypothesis: Fraudulent remote support sessions can start with Quick Assist process activity.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: Quick Assist Process Activity

1.json:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where FileName =~ "QuickAssist.exe"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by Timestamp desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
